headline: Uganda becomes final country to ratify African maritime transport charter
summary: Uganda became the 15th country to ratify the Revised African Maritime Transport Charter, the final endorsement needed to bring the African Union treaty into force after 15 years. Works and Transport Minister Fred Byamukama announced it.
why: The African Union maritime charter sets continental rules for shipping and maritime transport, which affect trade logistics and port operations across Africa. Entry into force typically shapes how member states regulate and coordinate their maritime sectors.
